title: Remote viewers foresee catastrophic sea level rise by 2050

tellings.quote: >> So, a number of remote viewers have remote viewed the year 2050.

plain: A researcher named Jason Jorjani, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels, says several remote viewers, people who claim to see distant places and times with the mind alone, have tried to look at the year 2050. He names Stephan Schwartz and Lyn Buchanan among them, and says they describe seas rising badly enough to drown coastal cities around the world.
